name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its view on the EU's rule-of-law budget rules. It says the rules have been used too rarely and too slowly, and only against Hungary so far. It asks the European Commission to act faster and more openly, to explain its decisions, and to protect people and groups who lose funding because of their government's actions. It also asks for a bigger say for Parliament. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The report asks for faster, more transparent use of the rules; no law changes yet.
- It affects Hungary, other member states, and groups receiving EU funds.
- Next, the Commission and Council respond; Parliament pushes for changes in the next long-term budget.
